description: Turn a template (or an already rendered HTML document) into a PDF via the tenant's hosted browser, and store it. Source: either template_id/key (+ variables) or document_id of an HTML document. Page size and margins come from the template's own CSS — nothing is added here, because two millimetres are enough to push a DIN 5008 address block out of the envelope window. Returns document_id; view it with get_document_link, send it with send_email(attachments) or send_letter(document_id). Needs a browser service under Integrations (provider 'browser').

document_id.description: An HTML document to convert, instead of a template.

title.description: Title of the stored PDF document

variables.description: Values for the template's {{placeholders}}; arrays of objects for {{#each list}} blocks.

name: render_document_pdf
